1001172.etyen:
An international chemical-nomenclature suffix, in Norwegian a specialized variant of -in (“chemical suffix”), remodelled under the influence of -yne (“alkyne-name suffix”). The English suffix was contracted from the ending -ylene in acetylene, and was incorporated into the systematic series -ane, -ene and -yne for hydrocarbons with single, double and triple carbon–carbon bonds, respectively.
Compare Danish -yn and Swedish -yn, as well as English -yne, French -yne, German -in and Finnish -yyni (“alkyne-name suffix”).
